name: Contest Gallery – Upload & Vote Photos, Media, Sell with PayPal & Stripe
author: Wasiliy Strecker / ContestGallery developer

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Contest Gallery through the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. The Contest Gallery menu appears on the left side of the WordPress admin area.
  3. Create a new gallery.
  4. Add entries or configure the frontend upload form.
  5. Insert [cg_gallery id="1"] into a page to display the gallery.
  6. Insert [cg_users_upload id="1"] into a page to display the upload form.

Documentation to configure different options: Click here..
sections.faq:
Can I approve files before they appear in the gallery?

Yes.

I would like to be informed when a file is uploaded.

That’s possible! You can activate to be informed after every frontend upload
and add an email where you like to be informed.

Is it possible to inform a user automatically when his image is activated for contest?

Yes. If the user added his e-mail during uploading his file he will be informed when the file
is activated. He can also receive a link in his mail which leads directly to his file.
Use option “Edit options” >>> “File activation e-mail” >>> “Send this activation e-mail when activating users files”.

Can I configure e-mail Body text which user receives?

Yes. You can configure Addressor, Reply mail, Cc mail, Bcc mail, Subject and Body text.
You can also insert a link in the mail Body text which will lead directly to his image.

Am I able to use WordPress Media Library for adding files to gallery?

Yes. You can use WordPress Media Library for uploading files and adding them to gallery.
In frontend uploaded files appears also in WordPress repository and in gallery.

Can I upload more then one file?

Yes. As default you can upload as many files as you want in backend.
Default in frontend is one file per upload. But you can configure
an amount you like. So you are also able to upload multiple files during one upload in frontend.

Can I add information to files?

Yes. You decide via “Edit upload form” which information can be added for every file.
It’s also possible to configure which information should appear frontend.

How many gallery contests can I run?

As many you like 🙂

How many files can I add to gallery?

Contest Gallery does not impose a limit on the number of gallery entries. The practical limit depends on your hosting storage and server resources.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team help validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.
sections.changelog:
33.0.1

  • FIXED: Regular product sandbox checkouts no longer require a Paid Actions sandbox link.
  • FIXED: Existing download sale settings can be saved after switching galleries without requiring regenerated watermark data.
  • IMPROVED: Upload PIN access now uses the gallery-specific text configured for logged-out visitors.
  • IMPROVED: Voting and upload login prompts now use passwordless email access with optional Google Sign-In.
  • IMPROVED: Custom voting HTML messages now use neutral bright and dark surfaces with vertically aligned content.
  • IMPROVED: Custom voting HTML messages now use bright and dark status cards while preserving interactive links and rich content.
  • FIXED: Visible one-star ratings no longer accept pointer interactions when voting is disabled.
  • NEW: Voting for cg_gallery can be enabled, shown read-only or hidden while other gallery shortcode variants remain independently configurable.
  • FIXED: Paid-action sign-in no longer reserves empty Google button space when Google is not configured and falls back to email when the button cannot load.
  • FIXED: Paid-action email PIN sign-in now places the full-width submit button below the email field.
  • FIXED: Read-only ecommerce rating visibility no longer authorizes direct voting requests.
  • FIXED: Legacy galleries with missing entry-opening settings now fall back to the full-window blog view instead of rendering a broken inline entry view.
  • IMPROVED: Legacy hash-URL galleries now show a clear backend migration notice that support has ended and recommend a complete copy with current entry URLs.

33.0.0

  • NEW: Sell upload, vote and comment credits directly from any regular gallery, with separate gross prices and a combined quantity checkout.
  • NEW: Customers can see persistent credit balances, sign in by Google or one-time email code, and return to the relevant gallery after payment.
  • NEW: Credits can remain gallery-local or be shared across participating galleries, while existing credit scopes stay unchanged.
  • NEW: Paid credit orders include audited absolute balance controls; full refunds revoke only unused credits from the refunded order.
  • IMPROVED: FREE clearly identifies paid upload, voting and comment credits as PRO functionality.
  • IMPROVED: General security hardening.
  • FIXED: Security issue.
  • FIXED: Multi-gallery overview shortcodes no longer inherit category filters, controls or empty-gallery text from an unrelated bootstrap gallery.
  • FIXED: Multi-gallery preview cards selected by highest rating or most comments now open the correct gallery reliably.
  • FIXED: One-star galleries with manually added votes now keep the complete visible total immediately after voting or undoing a vote.
  • FIXED: A first vote in a new browser now saves immediately when cookie checking and the vote-and-comment flow are enabled.
  • FIXED: The WordPress Media Library opened from “Add files / Social embed / OpenAI” now keeps the correct attachment grid width and vertical scrollbar.

Full updates history can be found in changelog.txt in plugins directory.
sections.description:
Create voting and upload galleries for photos, video, audio and files. Gallery monetization, social sharing and user registration.

All-in-One Photo Contest, Media Voting & File Gallery

Photo contest and media voting plugin supporting: JPG, PNG, GIF, ZIP, WEBM, MP4, MOV, TXT, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, CSV, MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A. Contest Gallery PRO additionally supports PDF uploads with generated previews.

Create galleries (material, modern, responsive) and allow users to vote and comment on files, photos, or embed social posts from YouTube, TikTok, X (Twitter) and more.

Live WordPress photo contest

See a responsive photo contest gallery with categories, voting and entry details in 10 seconds.

  • Watch all Contest Gallery 10-second feature demos

Popular WordPress gallery use cases

  • Photo Contests: Collect frontend submissions, organize categories, protect voting and choose winners. View the live photo contest example
  • SEO-Friendly Galleries: Publish descriptive entry pages with unique URLs, controlled indexing and structured media data. View the SEO-friendly gallery example
  • Video Contests: Accept video entries and combine focused playback with ratings and comments. View the video contest example
  • Product Review Galleries: Combine five-star average ratings with written feedback in a searchable gallery. View the product review example

Real Watermark Protection

Protect your image entries with real watermarks that are written into the public image files. Contest Gallery keeps the original files safely protected from direct public access, so you can present, share and sell your images with more confidence.

Key Features

  • Flexible Uploads: Create custom upload forms and add additional files to every entry.
  • Real Watermark Protection: Show watermarked public images while keeping the original files safely protected.
  • User Management: Includes user registration, login forms, and a “Google Sign-In button” for easy access.
  • Monetization: Sell entries or digital content directly via PayPal or Stripe API.
  • Social Reach: Built-in Social Media Share Buttons to boost your contest’s visibility.
  • No 100-entry limit: The former 100-entry limit was removed in 2019. Contest Gallery does not impose a limit on the number of gallery entries. Hosting storage and server resources still apply.

Paid uploads, votes and comments (PRO)

  • Contest Gallery PRO can sell upload, voting and comment credits directly from regular galleries.
  • Visitors can sign in with Google or a one-time email PIN and purchase credits through PayPal or Stripe.
  • Prices, taxes, currencies, invoices and order emails use the general Ecommerce configuration.
  • Compare the FREE and PRO versions feature by feature

Average ratings and comments

Combine five-star average ratings and comments in one clear two-step interaction.

Ecommerce PayPal and Stripe APIs available

  • Sell entries as shipping, download or service, or charge for uploads, via PayPal or Stripe API. Configure prices, shipping, taxes and currencies for your products. Configure checkout notes and agreements. Watermark image files, add download or service keys. Selling download or service and charging for uploads only available in PRO version.

Different file types upload form

  • Upload form for different file types
  • Manual or Auto-activation: Instantly display uploaded files in the gallery or review them first.
  • Different file types upload form and gallery example

See how visitors can prepare a complete photo-contest entry directly in the WordPress frontend.

Video contest gallery

Create responsive video contests with categories, ratings, comments and focused full-window playback.

PDF galleries with generated previews (PRO)

  • PDF uploads and generated preview images are available in Contest Gallery PRO.
  • Create real PDF preview images from the WordPress backend or a frontend upload form.
  • Display PDF entries with ratings, comments and other media files in the same gallery.
  • No Imagick installation is required.
  • PDFs with preview gallery and PDF upload form with preview example

Social Media Share Buttons

  • Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter, Telegram, Skype, Pinterest, Reddit, XING, LinkedIn, Email, SMS, Gmail, Yahoo, Evernote, VK, OK, Douban, RenRen, Qzone, Weibu
  • Real Custom Post Type Pages behind every entry… so real social share URLs
  • Social share buttons example

Add YouTube / Twitter / Instagram / TikTok Posts

  • Combine different file types and social embed posts in same gallery
  • Ask users for consent (GDPR) to show YouTube / Twitter / Instagram / TikTok entries option available.
  • YouTube and photos gallery example
  • Social media embeds and mixed file types gallery

OpenAI

  • Create or edit images via OpenAI API
  • Add created or edited images to your WordPress media library

External services

Contest Gallery Network

Contest Gallery Network is an optional public gallery directory operated at https://www.contest-gallery.net/.

The plugin contacts this service only when an administrator explicitly clicks “Publish to network” in the WordPress admin area and confirms the Contest Gallery Network privacy notice. After publishing, the listing is refreshed once daily by WordPress Cron while the plugin remains active. Administrators can remove the listing again with “Unpublish from Network”.

Submitted data includes public website and gallery listing information: website title and URL, gallery title, gallery description, tags/categories, the selected public gallery URL, preview image URLs, and public activity numbers such as entries, votes and comments.

The plugin does not submit IP addresses, email addresses, usernames, registration data, comment text, form field values or other private user data to Contest Gallery Network.

Contest Gallery Network may verify domain ownership, review submitted public content and images for safety, and publish the listing only if it passes review. If the service does not receive updates for 14 days, the public listing can expire and be removed from the Network index.

Service privacy policy: https://www.contest-gallery.net/privacy-policy/
Service terms: https://www.contest-gallery.net/terms-and-conditions/

FREE and PRO versions

  • The free version includes the core gallery, frontend upload, voting, commenting and sharing workflows.
  • Advanced workflows, including PDF uploads with generated preview images, are available only in Contest Gallery PRO.
  • Compare the FREE and PRO versions feature by feature

Upload form and gallery examples

  • Different file types upload form and gallery
  • Different galleries with different options on same page
  • Click through galleries on same page

Amazing contest for your WordPress page

Normal and registered user galleries

  • Display entries of all users
  • User see only own entries which were uploaded by the user after registration and login

Three voting types

  • IP recognition
  • Cookie recognition
  • Login session based (create account via registration form or Google sign in button and login)

Drag & Drop upload form creator

  • Add field types and arrange them
  • Add e-mail field and allow to send confirmation e-mail
  • Available field types: (Files Type, Input, Textarea, Select, Select Categories, Email, URL, Check agreement, HTML, Simple Captcha, Google reCAPTCHA)
  • Configure subscription e-mail

Drag & Drop user account registration form creator

  • Add field types and arrange them
  • Available field types: (WP-Last-Name, WP-First-Name, WP-Username, WP-Nickname, WP-Email, WP-Password, WP-Password-Confirm, Input, Textarea, Select, Check agreement, Profile Image, HTML, Simple Captcha, Google reCAPTCHA)
  • Allows membership as “Contest Gallery User” WordPress role

Create login area

  • Add login area to your website
  • Allow voting only for registered users

Three e-mail types

  • Admin information e-mail when new file is uploaded
  • Activation e-mail to user when his file is activated
  • Registration confirmation e-mail when user create a new account

Contest management

Manage activation, categories, entry details, comments, votes, winners and sales settings from one workspace.

Available options

Upload form options

  • Automatically activate user entries after successful frontend upload
  • Allow only registered users to upload files or to upload you
  • Restrict front end upload size
  • Maximum upload size in MB
  • Activate bulk upload in front end
  • Maximum number of files for bulk upload
  • Minimum number of files for bulk upload
  • Restrict resolution uploaded images
  • Activate in gallery upload form
  • Forward to another page after upload
  • Confirmation text after upload
  • Inform admin e-mail after upload in frontend
  • Inform entry activation e-mail
  • Inform successful entry e-mail

Registration options

  • Confirmation text after registration
  • Confirmation text after e-mail confirmation
  • Confirmation mail options (Addressor, Reply mail, Subject, Email content)

Login options

  • Forward to another page after login
  • Forward to URL
  • Confirmation text on same site after login
  • Confirmation Text after login

Vote options

  • Allow one-star favorite voting
  • Allow cumulative or average star ratings
  • Require a comment for voting, offer it as an optional follow-up or disable vote comments
  • Inform registered user when there was a vote for his entry
  • Show custom message after voting
  • Allow vote out of gallery
  • Hide voting until user voted
  • Configure votes amount per user
  • Show only user votes (user see only his votes not the whole rating)
  • Votes in time interval per user
  • Delete votes (frontend users can delete their votes and to another entry)

Commenting options

  • Allow comments
  • Allow comment out of gallery
  • Inform registered user when there was a comment for his entry
  • Review written comments
  • Remove written comments

Contest end options

  • End contest immediately
  • Activate contest end time

Gallery view options

  • Show images EXIF data
  • Add categories widget when categories field in upload form is added
  • Allow full window gallery
  • Number of files per screen (pagination)
  • Allow search for files (search by fields content, categories or file name)
  • Allow sort
  • Random sort
  • Random sort button
  • Configure gallery and entry behavior separately for supported shortcode types
  • Open entries in the responsive full-window blog view
  • Forward directly to the dedicated entry page or original source
  • Make gallery entries unclickable when only the overview should be shown

See the responsive gallery, full-window entry view and comment panel on a smartphone.

Single entry view options

  • View entries in the full-window blog view
  • Forward to the dedicated entry page
  • Link to original file source
  • Only gallery view

Backend language

  • English

Frontend languages

  • English
  • German
  • Dutch
  • Italian
  • Spanish
  • Portuguese
  • French
  • Polish
  • Slovakian
  • Norwegian (not complete)
  • Swedish (not complete)
  • Russian
  • Chinese
  • Own translations can be added in backend
